topic: What operational challenges arise in balancing power allocation between traffic-bearing beams and precoded pilot fields in superframe structures?
response: Interbeam interference and limited power flexibility can arise when balancing power allocation between traffic-bearing beams and precoded pilot fields in superframe structures. This is due to the dependency of interbeam interference on the power allocated to each beam, which can limit system performance and flexibility.
reference_context: The context mentions that interbeam interference is dependent on the power allocated to each beam and can affect total system performance. It also states that power allocation is necessary to optimally assign satellite resources due to their expense.
